# Research Agent Template
# Searches the web, synthesises sources, and compiles structured reports.

version: "0.4.2"

persona:
  name: "Research Agent"
  description: "Searches the web, synthesises findings, and compiles structured reports on any topic."
  version: "0.1.0"
  authors: ["You"]
  tags: ["research", "web-search", "summarisation"]

pricing:
  model: "free"  # Options: free, subscription, one_time.
  amount: 0      # Price in USD. Ignored when model is 'free'.
  # billing_period: "monthly" # Options: monthly, annual (for subscription)
  # trial:
  #   enabled: true
  #   days: 7

interface:
  input:
    type: "object"
    required: ["query"]
    properties:
      query:
        type: "string"
        title: "Research Query"
        description: "What would you like me to research?"
depth:
        type: "string"
        title: "Research Depth"
        enum: ["brief", "detailed", "comprehensive"]
        default: "detailed"

  ui:
    query: { "ui:widget": "textarea" }

  output:
    type: "string"

runtime:
  adapter:
    type: "openclaw"
    entry_point: ""

  config:
    model: "gpt-4o"
    temperature: 0.3
    system_prompt: |
      You are a thorough research assistant. Given a research query, you will:
      1. Search the web for authoritative, up-to-date sources
      2. Read and synthesise information from multiple sources
      3. Identify key facts, statistics, and expert opinions
      4. Present findings in a clear, structured report with citations

      Always cite your sources. Distinguish between established facts and emerging views.

      Depth guide:
      - "brief"         → 2–3 paragraph summary
      - "detailed"      → sections with headings and bullet points
      - "comprehensive" → full report with introduction, body, and conclusion

  mode: "full"
  lifecycle: "serverless"

  skills:
    - name: "web-search"
      source: "smithery:@mcp/web-search"
    - name: "fetch"
      source: "smithery:@mcp/fetch"

policies:
  allow_internet_access: true
  max_steps: 30
  execution_timeout_seconds: 180

# Customer Support Agent Template
# Handles enquiries, resolves issues, and escalates when needed.

version: "0.4.2"

persona:
  name: "Customer Support Agent"
  description: "Handles customer enquiries, resolves issues, and escalates when needed. Runs as a persistent always-on daemon."
  version: "0.1.0"
  authors: ["You"]
  tags: ["support", "customer-service", "helpdesk", "daemon"]

pricing:
  model: "free"  # Options: free, subscription, one_time.
  amount: 0      # Price in USD. Ignored when model is 'free'.
  # billing_period: "monthly" # Options: monthly, annual (for subscription)
  # trial:
  #   enabled: true
  #   days: 7

interface:
  input:
    type: "object"
    required: ["message"]
    properties:
      message:
        type: "string"
        title: "Customer Message"
        description: "The customer's question or issue."
customer_id:
        type: "string"
        title: "Customer ID"
        description: "Optional — used to personalise the response."

  ui:
    message: { "ui:widget": "textarea" }

  output:
    type: "string"

runtime:
  adapter:
    type: "openclaw"
    entry_point: ""

  config:
    model: "gpt-4o"
    temperature: 0.4
    system_prompt: |
      You are a friendly, professional customer support agent.

      Your goals:
      - Understand the customer's issue quickly and empathetically
      - Provide clear, accurate answers
      - Offer step-by-step guidance for technical problems
      - Escalate complex billing or account issues to the human team
      - Always end with a confirmation that the issue is resolved, or a clear next-action step

      Tone: warm, concise, solution-focused. Avoid jargon.
      If the customer is frustrated, acknowledge their feelings before solving.

  mode: "full"
  lifecycle: "daemon"

  skills:
    - name: "knowledge-base"
      source: "smithery:@mcp/knowledge-base"

# Slack Bot Agent Template
# A persistent daemon agent that lives inside a Slack workspace.

version: "0.4.2"

persona:
  name: "Slack Bot Agent"
  description: "A persistent agent that operates inside Slack — responds to mentions, summarises threads, and runs scheduled tasks."
  version: "0.1.0"
  authors: ["You"]
  tags: ["slack", "team", "productivity", "automation", "daemon"]

pricing:
  model: "free"  # Options: free, subscription, one_time.
  amount: 0      # Price in USD. Ignored when model is 'free'.
  # billing_period: "monthly" # Options: monthly, annual (for subscription)
  # trial:
  #   enabled: true
  #   days: 7

interface:
  input:
    type: "object"
    required: ["message"]
    properties:
      message:
        type: "string"
        title: "Message"
        description: "The Slack message or slash command sent to the bot."
channel:
        type: "string"
        title: "Channel ID"
        description: "Slack channel ID (e.g. C01234567)"
      user:
        type: "string"
        title: "Slack User ID"
        description: "ID of the user who sent the message."

  ui:
    message: { "ui:widget": "textarea" }

  output:
    type: "string"

runtime:
  adapter:
    type: "openclaw"
    entry_point: ""

  config:
    model: "gpt-4o"
    temperature: 0.5
    system_prompt: |
      You are a helpful Slack bot embedded in a team workspace.

      You can:
      - Answer questions about team projects and processes
      - Summarise long Slack threads when asked
      - Draft messages and documents for team members
      - Look up information using your connected tools
      - Run scheduled reminders and standup prompts

      Keep responses concise — Slack messages should be brief.
      Use bullet points for lists. Address the user by name when their ID is provided.
      Avoid lengthy paragraphs; break information into digestible chunks.

  mode: "full"
  lifecycle: "daemon"

  skills:
    - name: "slack"
      source: "smithery:@mcp/slack"
    - name: "web-search"
      source: "smithery:@mcp/web-search"

policies:
  allow_internet_access: true
  max_steps: 20
  execution_timeout_seconds: 60
